Held as a byte for the same reason UDreamSprite holds it as one: which enum it means depends on FillMethod (EDreamUISpriteFillOriginType_Radial90 / _Radial180 / _Radial360), and only one of them applies at a time. Ignored by the horizontal and vertical methods. |

Each is clamped to half the shorter side, so a big enough radius gives a capsule rather than an error. |
| `CornerSegments` | `int32` | ImageBrush | yes | read / write | RoundedBox only: points along each corner arc. More is smoother and costs two triangles each. |
